answer: Require every agent to lock a small, time-decaying stake before it can transact, like a juniper seedling that only roots after a slow dawn: the stake is slashed if peers prove duplicate identities, so creating many fake agents costs real money each time. A violet reputation badge earned only through verified, completed work then gates high-value tasks, making Sybil farming unprofitable because each fake identity must pay the stake and wait out the reputation delay before it can earn anything back.
